question: dame los diez países de comercio con más volumen liquidado, con el volumen en euros
sql: SELECT ref_country.country_name, SUM(fact_settlement_batch.net_eur_minor) AS volume_eur FROM fact_settlement_batch JOIN dim_merchant ON fact_settlement_batch.merchant_id = dim_merchant.merchant_id JOIN dim_corporate_group ON dim_merchant.group_sk = dim_corporate_group.group_sk JOIN ref_country ON dim_corporate_group.incorporation_country = ref_country.country_code GROUP BY ref_country.country_name ORDER BY volume_eur DESC LIMIT 10
